why: Josh marked job 009 on-track and said: "Its on track with #1 but the faults not good. Update the promt and run again." #1 is seed 231506249, the first image he was shown. 009 (the charsheet LoRA removed from 008, denoise 0.7) was the first job with visible shading, in 248 and 249. Its faults, per image: 246 had no shading and no stray objects; 247 was flat, with a headband on the front view, goggles on the back view with the tail, a black collar on the tailless back, and half-lidded eyes; 248 had the most shading, but a grey animal-face lump with a strap on the head in the back view with the tail, a grey muzzle there, the head turned sideways (symmetry lost), a head ratio of 0.186 and thin line (0.19%); 249 had soft shading, a goggle strap on the head in the side and back views, half-lidded eyes, a pink-grey belly tint and a head ratio of 0.188. This is one change: fault negatives only. The positive prompt is exactly 009's, with no shadow words weighted up (that is a separate later job). Negative changes: (1) '(headband:1.2), (headwear:1.2)' replace the plain 'headband, headwear' already there, to raise their weight; (2) added 'eyewear, sunglasses, eyewear on head, goggles, goggles on head, strap, collar' for the objects on the head and neck; (3) added '(half-closed eyes:1.2)' to the negative rather than adding 'wide eyes' to the prompt, because a prompt change would alter the positive and this job is negatives only, and the eye chunk already asks for large pupils. The known-faults table is followed: all added words name objects or an eye state, no body parts, to avoid the lower-back censor mark. The grey muzzle (248) is left alone: 'grey fur' and 'charcoal grey' are already in the negative and I see no clear fix. The pink-grey belly tint and the thin lines are also not addressed here. Everything else is exactly as in 009, so each image compares with its 009 twin: no charsheet LoRA, denoise 0.7, IP-Adapter ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h on the locked copy at 0.25 ending at 0.5, the locked less-human 246 parent, seeds 231506246-249 (4 images), Euler a, 30 steps, CFG 6, no hires.
